public_safe_claims: Evidence gating and conservative narrowing are stable workflow invariants in tested Route 2 scope.
Aggregation is a first-class decision seam.
Worst-case, distributional, and QA-dominant aggregation families are operationally distinct.
Cross-artifact broadening is stronger at workflow layer than at metric layer.
The broadened substrate is real but intentionally narrow.
product_guarded_claims: Same-task vs cross-task directional separation is useful but not fully class-parity complete.
Same-family intermediate and optional states are usable review categories with threshold guardrails.
Aggregation taxonomy is viable at coarse level; fine thresholds are non-canonical.
Behavioral profile distinctions are meaningful in current bounded panel.
research_only_claims: Routing-confusability behavioral non-transfer as a broad rule.
Collapse-vs-contamination as a cross-context law beyond current merge-facing evidence.

next_strengthening_targets: Run bounded behavioral replication across additional artifact slices without widening scenario scope.
